title: AutoCAD Designer-2D
description:
Job Description: 2D AutoCAD Designer – Interior & Tile Layouts

**Company:** M/s. Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Shamshabad, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Design – Product & Layout Division  
**Designation:** 2D AutoCAD Designer  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Working Schedule:** Day Shift  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Reporting To:** Design Head / Senior Architect

Job Summary

Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented **2D AutoCAD Designer** with practical experience in AutoCAD drafting, drawing tracing, tile layouts, marble flooring, wall elevations and natural stone designs.

The candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate 2D technical drawings, tracing existing architectural plans, developing tile and stone layouts, and converting design references into precise, execution-ready AutoCAD drawings for premium residential and commercial interior projects.

Candidates should demonstrate strong drafting skills, dimensional accuracy, attention to detail and an interest in building a long-term career with the Company.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare detailed 2D AutoCAD drawings for floor layouts, wall elevations, tile inlays, stone cladding and decorative stone patterns.
* Trace and reproduce existing architectural drawings, floor plans, wall elevations, sketches, PDFs, images and design references in AutoCAD.
* Identify and interpret measurements, dimensions, patterns and design elements from existing drawings and convert them into accurate, editable AutoCAD files.
* Develop tile, marble and natural stone layouts, including dimensions, joint details, pattern alignment and material orientation.
* Interpret architectural drawings, site measurements and client requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales, Design and Production teams to ensure technical accuracy and project requirements.
* Revise and update drawings based on internal reviews, client feedback and site requirements.
* Maintain organised drawing files, technical documentation and reusable design templates.
* Prepare design presentations, layout mock-ups and supporting technical drawings.
* Verify dimensions, scaling, alignment and technical details before final submission.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Strong proficiency in **AutoCAD 2D drafting and drawing tracing** is mandatory.
* Educational qualification in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Ability to trace drawings from PDFs, scanned plans, images, sketches and architectural references.
* Practical understanding of tiles, marble, natural stone, stone cladding and tile joints.
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings and convert design concepts into technical layouts.
* Good understanding of dimensions, scaling, proportions and drawing accuracy.
* Good communication skills in English, Hindi and Telugu.
* Willingness to work from the Company's Shamshabad office.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Italian marble, sandstone, designer tiles and natural stone.
* Knowledge of SketchUp, Photoshop or other design presentation software.
* Understanding of material wastage, cutting patterns, layout optimisation and installation requirements.
* Exposure to premium residential, commercial or hospitality interior projects.

Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates must undergo a practical AutoCAD technical assessment, which may include:

* Tracing an existing architectural drawing.
* Interpreting dimensions and measurements.
* Preparing a 2D tile or wall stone layout.
* Demonstrating drafting accuracy and technical understanding.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with relevant AutoCAD drawings or portfolio samples.

**Email:** hr@celestile.com  
**Contact / WhatsApp:** +91 80080 03232

Candidates should be prepared to attend an in-person interview and technical assessment at our Shamshabad office.

Benefits

* Provident Fund (PF), as applicable.
* Health Insurance, as per Company policy.

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** In Person – Shamshabad, Hyderabad

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

description:
**Job Summary**

* Prepare clear, step-by-step production procedures for the factory covering:

* Profile shutters
* Partition systems
* PU shutters

* Prepare daily/weekly production reports for management.

**4. Coordination**

* Coordinate between the design team, sales/showrooms, and factory supervisors to clarify specifications.
* Follow up on order status, material readiness, and delivery timelines.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Basic 2D AutoCAD** drawing skills.
* Ability to read and understand drawings and measurements.
* Good written communication, so procedures are clear and simple.
* Strong attention to detail, with good organisation and time management.
* Ability to work with both office and factory teams.

**Preferred (Good to Have)**

**About PropertyScan** PropertyScan is a cutting-edge real estate technology and CRM platform designed for developers, builders, brokers, and realtors. Our software turns traditional physical yard signs into instant digital lead-capture machines. We are a fast-growing SaaS company looking to scale our digital presence through high-converting, scroll-stopping video advertisements.

**The Role** We are expanding our creative team and are actively looking for freelance talent at **all experience levels (Intern/Entry-Level, Junior, and Senior)**. You will be responsible for producing 30- to 60-second video ads optimized for the Meta ecosystem (Facebook & Instagram Reels, Stories, and In-Feed).

Unlike standard video editing, this role requires a unique blend of **UI/UX motion graphics** (making software dashboards look dynamic and exciting) and **AI video generation** (using prompt engineering to create cinematic B-roll).

**What You Will Do**

* **Ad Production:** Edit and assemble fast-paced, high-converting 60-second commercials based on provided scripts and storyboards.
* **UI/SaaS Animation:** Take raw dashboard screenshots of the PropertyScan software and recreate them as stylized, highly legible motion graphics in After Effects (animating cursors, lead pipelines, and data charts).
* **AI Integration:** Utilize generative AI tools (e.g., Runway Gen-2/Gen-3, Midjourney, HeyGen, ElevenLabs) to generate cinematic b-roll, voiceovers, and visual assets.
* **Format Optimization:** Ensure all deliverables are perfectly formatted for mobile viewing (9:16 Vertical and 4:5 Aspect Ratios).
* *For Seniors:* Lead the creative direction of ad campaigns, develop new visual hooks, and A/B test variations to improve ad performance.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* **Location:** Must be based in India. Freelancers residing in Andhra Pradesh (AP) or Telangana (Hyderabad, Vizag, Vijayawada, etc.) are highly preferred for easier team alignment and communication.
* **Software Skills:** Proficiency in Adobe After Effects (mandatory for UI animation) and Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut.
* **AI Knowledge:** Hands-on experience (or a strong willingness to learn for Interns/Entry-level) with AI video and image generation platforms.
* **Portfolio:** You MUST provide a link to your portfolio or showreel. *Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.*

**Requirements by Level:**

* **Senior (3+ Years Experience):** Expert-level motion graphics skills. You have a proven track record of creating profitable video ads for SaaS products or apps. You don't just edit; you understand marketing psychology, pacing, and retention.
* **Junior (1-3 Years Experience):** Strong editing foundation and solid After Effects skills. You know how to animate text and graphics cleanly and are eager to master AI video tools.
* **Intern / Entry-Level (0-1 Year Experience):** You are hungry, creative, and tech-savvy. You know your way around video editing software, are obsessed with social media trends, and want to build your freelance portfolio by creating commercial-grade ads.

**Why Work With Us?**

* 100% Remote / Work-from-home flexibility.
* Work on the cutting edge of AI video production and SaaS marketing.
* Potential for a long-term freelance retainer or ongoing, consistent project work as our ad campaigns scale.

**How to Apply:** Please submit your resume along with a **link to your portfolio/reel**. If you have examples of software/UI animation, motion graphics, or videos utilizing AI generation, please highlight them in your application!

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Principal Product Designer – Infrastructure**


### **Your opportunity**



As a Principal Product Designer on New Relic's Infrastructure design team, you'll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications — cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF\-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP\- and SVP\-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. You'll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.



We care more about how you think than what you've already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work — someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when it's ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.



You'll set craft and design\-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid\-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US\-based team.


### **What you'll do**


* **Infrastructure \& complex data visualization**: Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible — reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
* **System coherence \& fail\-safe UX**: Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root\-cause investigation.
* **Own the product vision**: Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go\-to\-market.
* **Go deep on the technology**: Build real fluency in the systems you're designing for — cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals — through direct conversations with engineers, hands\-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
* **User research**: Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
* **AI\-forward evolution**: Partner with engineering and product to bring AI\-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
* **Team leadership \& craft**: Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid\-level designers, and represent the team's design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
* **Design at scale**: Drive large\-scale, cross\-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth \& Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

### **This role requires**


* 12\+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data\-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
* Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology — evidence that you've taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
* Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
* Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component\-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems\-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
* Solid grasp of WCAG 2\.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
* Ability to connect design work to business outcomes — mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
* Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
* A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP\- or SVP\-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
* An external professional presence in the design community — conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic — consistent with the seniority of this level.

### **Bonus points if you have**


* Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer\-facing tooling.
* Prior exposure to designing for AI\-assisted or LLM\-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI\-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
* A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
* Strong facilitation skills for cross\-functional design sprints and workshops.

### **BUSINESS GOALS**



This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response — the gap between a high\-level "something's wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relic's Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI\-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio\-level vision for that complexity — one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well\-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean\-time\-to\-resolution.


**What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire?**



* Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio\-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.


* AI\-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human\-in\-the\-loop interaction models for AI\-assisted anomaly detection and root\-cause analysis in Infrastructure.


* Process maturation: help standardize cross\-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF\-based instrumentation).


* Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.


* Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth \& Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.
  

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.



If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.



We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.


**Our hiring process**  

  

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.  

  

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.  

  

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.



Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Service Design Intern (Systems Design & Operations Focus)
description:
**Location:** Hyderabad \| (In\-Person Role)  

**Role Type:** 6\-Month Internship (Full\-Time Offer Contingent on Performance)  

**Department:** Systems \& Service Design


**About TRD Studios**


TRD Studios is a new\-age, integrated Management \+ Experience Studio. We specialize in transforming chaotic, fragmented enterprise operations into scalable, high\-margin architectures. As experts in Business Services and Systems Design, we approach organisational bottlenecks by looking beyond the physical machinery to understand the invisible structures governing human behavior.


We firmly believe in Conway’s Law, which posits that organisations will inevitably design systems that mirror their own internal communication structures. Therefore, our interventions go far beyond throwing software at a problem. We engineer human behavior, establish unified command structures, and design pragmatic digital architectures that respect the physical realities of the workspace.


**The Role:** Service Design Intern


We are seeking a highly analytical and curious Service Design Intern with a strong inclination toward Systems Thinking. In this role, you will transcend traditional UX/UI design. You will not just be designing screens; you will be architecting entire operational ecologies.


Working closely with our Lead Service Designers, you will help untangle complex B2B and B2C operations. You will be instrumental in mapping the intersections where customer interactions (Frontstage), internal business processes (Backstage), information architecture, and physical material workflows collide. Your work will directly inform the creation of Minimum Viable Systems (MVS) designed to protect operational flow, eradicate undocumented “shadow queues,” and establish unified command structures for our enterprise clients.


The 6\-Month Journey \& Core Responsibilities (The 5D Framework)


Because systemic change requires observation, iteration, and behavioural embedding, this internship spans a rigorous 6\-month period. Your responsibilities will actively map to our 5D Framework:


**1\. Discover: Deep\-Dive System \& Behavioural Mapping**


* **Operational Ecology Mapping:** Assist in mapping the actual production, material, and information flow of our clients, rather than just documenting their intended organisational charts.
* **Stakeholder \& Power Dynamics:** Utilise frameworks like the Stakeholder Influence Map to identify informal power centres, document how conflicts are resolved, and understand who truly influences priorities on the ground.
* **Value Stream Mapping (VSM):** Track the physical flow of materials and inventory to identify spatial congestion, supply chain visibility gaps, and undocumented routing that traps capital in dead stock.


**2\. Define: Synthesizing Systemic Constraints**


* **Root Cause Analysis:** Help distill chaotic shop\-floor symptoms into defined problem statements grounded in observed behaviour.
* **Friction Point Identification:** Compile lists of operational pain points ranked by their systemic impact on overall throughput, revenue, and scalability.


**3\. Design \& Develop: Architecting Minimum Viable Systems**


* **Service Blueprinting:** Draft comprehensive, end\-to\-end service blueprints that visualize the lines of interaction, lines of visibility, and internal support processes.
* **Operational Rulebooks \& SOPs:** Collaborate in designing simple, algorithmic production Priority Rulebooks, Material Readiness Checklists, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that replace reactive firefighting.
* **Pragmatic Digital Architecture:** Translate designed physical processes into pragmatic digital ERP staging requirements. You will ensure that digital interfaces respect environmental constraints of workers handling heavy machinery who cannot easily navigate complex touchscreens.


**4\. Deliver: Scaling, Piloting, and Measurement**


* **Pilot Observation:** Support the rollout of controlled production pilots. You will observe daily standups, track early operational metrics, and document human failure points during adoption.
* **KPI Tracking:** Assist in defining and measuring operational KPIs that align daily behaviour with strategic goals (e.g., on\-time delivery percentages, work order lead times, and inventory days).


The Mindset \& Qualifications We Are Looking For


* **Systems Thinker:** You possess the ability to zoom out and view a business not as isolated departments, but as a complex, interconnected ecology.
* **Behavioural Empathy:** You understand that operational paralysis is rarely a technology issue; it is a symptom of informal communication, infinite Work\-In\-Progress (WIP) limits, and an absence of unified command.
* **Methodological Rigor:** Familiarity with industry\-standard frameworks such as Service Blueprinting, Value Stream Mapping, RACI matrices, and Minimum Viable Systems (MVS).
* **Analytical Detective:** You are comfortable diving into raw data, conducting stakeholder interviews, and identifying the “invisible structures” that override the intended logic of a business.
* **Design Tool Proficiency:** Competency in tools like Figma, Miro, or similar mapping software to create highly granular, readable system overview maps, process charts, and UI mockups for internal dashboards.


Internship Terms \& Next Steps


* **Duration:** The internship period will be for **6 months**.
* **Career Progression:** We view this internship as an intensive incubator for future leaders. **A full\-time offer will be given based on performance** at the successful conclusion of the 6\-month period.
* **Why TRD?**  

This is not a theoretical internship. You will be exposed to the raw, unfiltered reality of enterprise operations. You will learn how to pragmatically bridge the gap between high\-level business strategy and ground\-level execution, developing a robust portfolio that showcases your ability to engineer real\-world business scale.


**To Apply or Inquire:** Please send your resume, portfolio (showcasing systems thinking, mapping, or service design projects), and a brief introduction to our design team. **Contact us at** \[email protected] **if you have any questions on the role.**

description:
#### **About TRD Studios**


At **TRD Studios**, we are pioneering a transformative approach to entrepreneurship and innovation. As a dynamic ecosystem builder, TRD Studios operates at the nexus of creativity, technology, and sustainability, empowering startups, enterprises, and aspiring entrepreneurs to bring their bold visions to life.


Our flagship initiative, the **TRD Residential Entrepreneurship Experience (TREE)** program, is designed to foster talent, inspire innovation, and enable transformative growth across diverse sectors, including Fintech, HealthTech, Gaming, MediaTech, Manufacturing, and beyond. Central to our mission is the **ISTAM Framework (Information Structures for Thought and Action in Management)**, a proprietary methodology that combines structured thinking, proactive decision\-making, and action\-oriented learning to drive entrepreneurial success. This framework forms the backbone of our programs, offering participants a strategic roadmap for navigating complex business landscapes.


At TRD Studios, we champion collaboration through partnerships with incubators, accelerators, regulators, and corporates, creating an ecosystem that fuels value creation and sustained growth. With a multidisciplinary, innovation\-driven environment, we are committed to equipping the next generation of entrepreneurs, venture partners, and industry leaders with the tools to reimagine the world and shape the future.  

  

**Work Culture**


At TRD Studios, we foster a **learning\-driven environment** where creativity, collaboration, and curiosity are encouraged. Interns are not just observers but active contributors to our projects. Here’s what you can expect:


* You’ll be paired with a **dedicated mentor** to guide you throughout the internship.
* You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table, and your contributions will be valued and implemented.
* A professional environment where **punctuality**, respect for confidentiality (through an **NDA**), and teamwork are highly prioritized.

#### **Who Should Apply?**


We are looking for **multidisciplinary interns** who are eager to learn and contribute in one or more of the following areas:


* **Design** (Product, UX/UI, Industrial Design)
* **Management** (Business Strategy, Operations)
* **Legal Research**
* **Finance** (Financial Modeling, Accounting, Business Analysis)
* **Marketing** (Digital Marketing, Branding, Content Strategy)
* **Supply Chain** (Logistics, Procurement, Distribution)


Whether you’re a designer interested in creating real\-world solutions, a finance expert eager to develop business models, or a legal researcher contributing to the **Generative AI platform** we’re building, there’s a place for you at TRD Studios.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


**General Responsibilities (for all roles):**


* Work on **brand\-specific projects** such as **Go Banjara**, **HumSatva**, **Rooomin**, and others.
* Contribute to **operational strategies** that enhance business efficiency and scalability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to **deliver real\-world solutions**.
* Engage in **problem\-solving**, innovation, and proposing **new strategies** based on the industry you’re working in.


**Role\-Specific Responsibilities:**


**1\. Design (Product, UX/UI, Industrial Design)**:


* Work on the development of product designs for TRD brands.
* Create user\-centric designs that meet client needs and enhance **brand experiences**.
* Participate in the **design process**, from ideation to prototyping, ensuring alignment with TRD Studios’ product strategy.


**2\. Management (Business Strategy, Operations)**:


* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for **operational improvements**.
* Develop **business strategies** for TRD’s brands to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Work closely with project teams to ensure **timely delivery** of solutions, while maintaining operational excellence.


**3\. Legal Research**:


* Conduct **regulatory analysis** and research **compliance laws** relevant to various industries, with a focus on Indian and international standards.
* Assist in structuring legal data for our **Generative AI platform for legal compliance**, ensuring that it is optimized for automation.
* Perform **case law research** and provide insights on legal trends that can be integrated into AI\-driven compliance systems.
* Collaborate with AI teams to ensure legal data is correctly implemented into the platform’s decision\-making algorithms.


**4\. Finance (Financial Modeling, Accounting, Business Analysis)**:


* Develop **financial models** to support business strategy and long\-term planning for TRD Studios’ brands.
* Perform **market analysis** to assist in pricing strategies, revenue forecasting, and investment opportunities.
* Support the finance team in **budget planning**, financial reporting, and analyzing key business metrics.


**5\. Marketing (Digital Marketing, Branding, Content Strategy)**:


* Assist in the development and execution of **marketing strategies** for TRD brands, enhancing their digital presence.
* Work on **brand campaigns** to increase visibility and customer engagement.
* Develop **content strategies** for social media, websites, and promotional materials.


**6\. Supply Chain (Logistics, Procurement, Distribution)**:


* Analyze existing **supply chain processes** and identify areas for optimization, especially within TRD brands like **Go Banjara**.
* Work on procurement and logistics strategies that ensure efficient product delivery and cost\-effectiveness.
* Assist in creating a streamlined **distribution network** for new product launches.

#### **Eligibility Criteria**


* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **design, business, law, finance, marketing**, or **supply chain**management.
* Strong **communication skills** and a passion for learning and innovation.
* Ability to work effectively in a **team environment**.
* Availability for a **minimum duration of 3 months** for the internship.
